_doc: MVP starting rules. See design/DESIGN_RULES.md for why each value is what it is.

clock._doc: A day is day_seconds of real time and starts in the morning (Day N, 00 s is daylight, as in the reference screens). Phases are fractions of the day; the sky, light and anything that cares about night read them from here.

progression._doc: EXP needed to go from level N to N+1 is exp_to_next[N-1]; past the end of the list the last step repeats growing by `growth`. Step 16 tunes these.

land._doc: Price of the k-th purchased cell (k = 0 for the first): round_to * ceil(base * growth^k / round_to). Only cells sharing an edge with owned land can be bought.

economy._doc: How many days of money history to keep (status/analytics read it).
